styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: ROM, AGO, Casa Loma and the Distillery District.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Markets, dim sum, Kensington and a big brunch scene.

styles.label: Family
styles.blurb: CN Tower, the islands ferry and the aquarium.

stays.why: Walk to the CN Tower, the waterfront and the main subway lines. Easiest base for a first visit.
Quiet, upscale blocks near the ROM and good restaurants. Two subway stops from downtown.
Next to King West bars, theatres and the Rogers Centre. Lively at night, sometimes noisy.
Cobbled, car-free lanes with galleries and cafés. A short streetcar ride east of the core.

food: Try a peameal bacon sandwich at St. Lawrence Market; go early, many stalls close by mid-afternoon.
Chinatown and Kensington Market are close together: dim sum, dumplings and cheap tacos in one walk.
Poutine, butter tarts and a Toronto-style brunch are the local staples; expect CAD 15–30 for a main.
Book dinner ahead on weekends in King West and Yorkville; walk-ins are hard after 7pm.
Tipping is expected: about 15–20% on the bill, and it is often added to larger groups.
more_time: Take the short ferry to the Toronto Islands for skyline views and a picnic; check the day's schedule.
Ride the subway to the Royal Ontario Museum and the AGO in one day if museums are your thing.
Day trip to Niagara Falls by train or bus; it is a long day, so start early.

recommend.why: Two nights covers the CN Tower, a museum and the Distillery District; add a night for the islands or a Niagara day trip.

month_notes: Coldest month: highs near 0°C, lows around -7°C. Pack a warm coat, hat and gloves.
Similar to January, lows near -8°C. Indoor sights and the PATH walkways help.
Still cold: highs around 5°C, lows near -3°C. Expect some rain or wet snow.
Warming up: highs near 10°C, lows around 2°C. Rain on about 13 days, so bring a jacket.
Pleasant: highs near 18°C, lows around 8°C. Good month for walking and the islands.
Warm and green: highs near 23°C, lows around 14°C. Patio season begins.
Hot: highs near 26°C, lows around 18°C. Busy tourist month; book ahead.
Similar to July: highs near 26°C, lows around 17°C. Warm evenings suit the waterfront.
Mild and comfortable: highs near 22°C, lows around 14°C. A strong month to visit.
Cooler: highs near 15°C, lows around 8°C. Fall colours and more rain days.
Chilly: highs near 8°C, lows around 1°C. Layer up; some rain.
Cold again: highs near 3°C, lows around -3°C. Expect rain or snow on about 12 days.

climate_guide.summary: Continental climate with cold winters and warm, humid summers. Rain falls year-round, spread over many days.

items.title: Best time: May to September
items.text: Highs from 18°C to 26°C and mild evenings. Best for walking, the islands and patios.

items.title: Winter is cold (December to February)
items.text: Highs near 0°C to 3°C and lows down to -8°C. Bring a heavy coat, hat and gloves.

items.title: Rain in every month
items.text: About 9–13 rain days a month. April and October are the wettest; pack a light rain jacket.

items.title: Summer can be humid
items.text: July and August highs near 26°C with muggy spells. Carry water and plan indoor breaks.

items.title: Spring and fall are mild
items.text: May and September are comfortable, around 18–22°C. Good shoulder-season months.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Layers for cool evenings, a waterproof jacket, and warm boots in winter. Comfortable shoes for walking.

transit.best: Walk downtown and use the TTC subway and streetcars; tap a PRESTO or contactless card.

modes.text: TTC subway Lines 1 and 2 cover downtown well. Tap a PRESTO card or contactless card to ride.
Buses and streetcars run frequently. The King Street streetcar is transit-only through the core.
Taxis are metered. Uber and Lyft both operate widely.
Driving is grid-easy, but downtown parking is costly and rush hour is heavy.
Best way to see downtown. Bike Share Toronto is handy along the waterfront.
A short free ferry and pedestrian tunnel link Billy Bishop Airport to the mainland.
